answer: Bind each key to a tenured mobile line. At join and every 30 days the agent proves one SIM through the carrier's GSMA Number Verify API; VoIP and virtual numbers are rejected, and a SIM Swap hit under 90 days freezes payouts. A salted line hash merges duplicate keys. A farm of 100 sybils needs 100 postpaid lines aged 90+ days, about $1,500/mo, while an honest agent pays $15 and is no lonely island. Shared family plans go to a raven-eyed jury, not auto-merge; the appeal acts like yarrow on a cut: show separate billing names and the seat heals.
